name: QuickView – Instant Product Preview
author: Kirtikumar Solanki

sections.description:
The QuickView – Instant Product Preview plugin for WooCommerce allows customers to preview product details instantly via an AJAX-powered modal. This enables a better shopping experience by providing a quick, modal-based preview of products without leaving the shop page.

Key Features

  • AJAX-powered modal product preview.
  • Allows customers to view product details instantly.
  • Seamlessly integrates with WooCommerce product pages.
  • Quick View button customization options.
  • Modal background color and button color customizations.
  • Enable quick view on mobile.
  • Show product details like images, price, and description.
  • Easily customizable button positions and styles.

Usage

Once activated, the plugin will add a Quick View button on your WooCommerce product listings. Customers can click the button to open a modal preview of the product.

Quick View Settings

  • Button Position: Choose where the Quick View button appears on the product page. Options include after the image, after the title, or before the add to cart button.
  • Enable Quick View on Mobile: This option lets you enable or disable Quick View functionality on mobile devices.
  • Button Label & Color: Customize the label of the Quick View button and its color to match your site’s theme.
  • Product Detail View: You can choose to show or hide specific product details (like images, price, and description) in the modal.

Customization Options

  1. Modal Background Color: Choose a color for the background of the product preview modal.
  2. Closing Button: Customize the color of the closing button, including the hover effect.
  3. Navigation Box: Change the background color and text color of the navigation box in the modal.

Credits

Developed by Kirtikumar Solanki.
Donations welcome via PayPal.
sections.installation:
1. Download and install the plugin via the WordPress admin dashboard:

    • Go to Plugins > Add New.
    • Click Upload Plugin and choose the downloaded .zip file.
    • Install and activate the plugin.

  2. Alternatively, you can manually install the plugin by uploading it to the wp-content/plugins directory on your server.
sections.faq:
1. How do I enable the Quick View feature on my site?

After installing and activating the plugin, the Quick View button will automatically appear on product listings. You can adjust its position, appearance, and the details shown in the modal through the plugin settings.

2. Can I change the position of the Quick View button?

Yes, you can change the position of the Quick View button in the plugin settings. Options include:
– After Image
– After Title
– Before Add to Cart Button

3. Does this work on mobile devices?

Yes! The plugin provides an option to enable or disable Quick View functionality on mobile devices. You can manage this setting in the plugin’s options.

4. How can I customize the look of the Quick View modal?

You can customize the look of the modal, including:
– Modal background color
– Closing button color
– Navigation box background and text colors

These options are available under the Style Options section in the plugin settings.

5. Can I display product ratings in the Quick View modal?

Yes! You can enable or disable the display of product ratings inside the Quick View modal in the plugin’s settings.
